proposal.summary: The Administrator section of the Surveillance module in Global RADAR - BSA Radar 1.6.7234.24750 and lower contains a Local File Inclusion vulnerability in /UC/downloadFile.ashx via the FileName parameter allowing viewing of local files on the web server when the requester has valid privileges.
proposal.cwe_quote: When downloading the files, a user is able to view local files on the web server by manipulating the FileName and FilePath parameters in the URL, or while using a proxy.

AV.quote: The entire LFI path can be injected into the "FileName" parameter in order to enumerate existing files on the server.

PR.quote: The current user is required to have valid privileges to send requests to the target vulnerable endpoint.

C.quote: This vulnerability could be used to view local sensitive files or configuration files on the backend server.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Validate the issue by reproducing the GET request against a test instance with an account having the stated valid privileges, confirm files retrievable, and apply input validation/whitelisting or path sanitization on FileName/FilePath; if confirmed, prepare coordinated disclosure to vendor and advise patch or mitigation (restrict access, disable download endpoint).
